_comment: select_for is a capability match, not a lookup - if either half of the match (chipset prefix, state membership) stops being checked, a flasher could be handed a device it never declared it can write. The RP2040-BOOTSEL carve-out is the one case that's supposed to refuse even though the chipset is recognised; losing that silently turns a clear 'not wired up yet' into either a wrong flasher or a wrong error.

mutations.name: state has to be one this flasher actually declares
mutations.find: if state in f.states and any(chipset.startswith(p) for p in f.chipsets):
mutations.replace: if True and any(chipset.startswith(p) for p in f.chipsets):

mutations.name: chipset has to match one of this flasher's own prefixes
